projects.title: Projects
projects.description: A collection of engineering projects detailing technical challenges, core solutions, and features.

employeeSpringBoot.title: Gestion des Employés – Spring Boot
employeeSpringBoot.description: Enterprise human resource management platform built with Spring Boot and a custom HTML/CSS interface to digitalize recruiting and onboarding pipelines.
employeeSpringBoot.challenge: HR and recruitment processes were heavily paper-based, leading to high processing latency and onboarding friction for candidates.
employeeSpringBoot.solution: Developed a high-performance HR platform with modular dashboards, digital records management, and automated leave request workflows.
features: End-to-end recruitment pipeline tracker
Fully bilingual interface (English/French)
Modular employee directory with search and filters
Direct manager email notification systems

employeeAspNet.title: Gestion des Employés – ASP.NET MVC
employeeAspNet.description: Enterprise-level administrative console for corporate directory and role-based access control.
employeeAspNet.challenge: Fragmented employee records made tracking attendance and managing custom permissions difficult for administrators.
employeeAspNet.solution: Built a centralized system featuring role-based dashboards, secure JWT login, and robust CRUD endpoints for employee lifecycle management.
features: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) security model
Automated attendance logs and leave tracking
One-click Excel payroll reports generator
System audit trails tracking administrative changes

connectify.title: Connectify
connectify.description: Real-time visual feed and collaboration space featuring interactive messaging and responsive UI, powered by Supabase.
connectify.challenge: Designing a real-time reactive feed and instant messaging interface that scales gracefully under concurrent user traffic.
connectify.solution: Crafted a React single page application backed by a Node.js API and Supabase for realtime data and storage, delivering instant messaging feedback.
features: Instant messaging with real-time delivery status
Dynamic feed engine with post sharing
Like and comment reactions with real-time counts
Fully responsive layout built for mobile & desktop

employeeAndroid.title: App Mobile Gestion des Employés
employeeAndroid.description: Native Android directory application for managing employee records on the go.
employeeAndroid.challenge: Field managers needed a lightweight, reliable way to browse and manage employee records without depending on a desktop system.
employeeAndroid.solution: Engineered a native Android application in Java with a local SQLite database, giving managers fast, offline-friendly access to employee data.
features: Employee directory with search and filters
Local database persistence for offline access
Direct contact calling and email shortcuts from profiles
Modern Material Design 3 user interface

transRoto.title: Trans Roto
transRoto.description: Transport and route management web app for planning, assigning, and tracking vehicle routes.
transRoto.challenge: Coordinating vehicle routes, driver assignments, and schedules manually made transport operations slow and error-prone.
transRoto.solution: Built a React front-end backed by a MySQL database to centralize route planning, vehicle assignment, and trip tracking.
features: Route creation and assignment dashboard
Vehicle and driver management
Trip status tracking in real time
MySQL-backed persistent records and history

weatherApp.title: Application Météo
weatherApp.description: Weather forecasting web application delivering current conditions and forecasts for any city.
weatherApp.challenge: Users needed a fast, clean way to check accurate weather data without sifting through cluttered weather sites.
weatherApp.solution: Built a Django-powered web app that fetches and caches weather data, rendering it through a clean, responsive interface.
features: City search with current conditions and multi-day forecast
Server-side data caching to reduce API calls
Clean, responsive interface across devices
Error handling for invalid or unavailable locations

hospitalManagement.title: Gestion des Hospitalisations
hospitalManagement.description: C++ desktop application for managing patient admissions, ward assignments, and discharge records.
hospitalManagement.challenge: Manual tracking of patient admissions and bed assignments was error-prone and hard to audit.
hospitalManagement.solution: Developed a structured C++ application to manage patient records, admissions, and discharge workflows with organized data storage.
features: Patient registration and admission tracking
Ward and bed assignment management
Discharge and billing summary generation
Structured, auditable record storage

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: My professional journey, combining software engineering, AI-driven automation, and business methods.

atos.role: Software Engineering Intern — E2E Test Automation via AI Agent (PFE)
points: Designed and developed a hybrid AI agent (deterministic scripts + LLM execution) automating 14+ complex B2B sales journeys on the Salesforce Lightning CRM for client inwi (telecom operator).

Architected an orchestrator driven by a declarative flow file (error recovery, anti-timeout checkpoints, state persistence) and controlled the browser via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and the MCP protocol.
Migrated the agent between two AI assistants: diagnosed behavioral divergences and rewrote orchestration rules, validated end-to-end on a full sales journey.
Built a Python supervision dashboard deployed continuously on server, with automatic detailed report generation at the end of each execution run.
Designed and implemented clean, responsive interfaces for administrative dashboards.
Refactored legacy REST APIs and optimized SQL database queries, improving performance by 25%.
Collaborated with project managers in an Agile (Scrum) workflow to deliver production-ready features.
Architected enterprise projects using Spring Boot, C#, and React.
Created custom solvers for operations research models, graphing pathfinding algorithms in Java.
Engineered secure relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) with advanced audit triggers.
Mastered advanced concepts in software architecture, design patterns, and system design.
Developed full-stack web and mobile apps following test-driven development (TDD).
Managed team repositories with strict Git branching strategies and continuous integration (CI).
